claims.verbatim_quote: The Hwange Thermal Power Station Unit 7 and 8 expansion project undertaken by Sinohydro broke ground on June 27, 2018.
claims.claim_text: Sinohydro Corporation is the EPC contractor for Hwange Units 7 & 8 expansion, groundbreaking 27 June 2018.

claims.verbatim_quote: President Mnangagwa commissioned the US$1.5bn Hwange Power Station expansion project on August 4, 2023.
claims.claim_text: Hwange Units 7 & 8 commissioned 4 August 2023.

claims.verbatim_quote: Zimbabwe's Kariba South Hydropower Station, expanded by Sinohydro, was commissioned on March 28, 2018.
claims.claim_text: Sinohydro expanded Kariba South hydropower station, commissioned 28 March 2018.

claims.verbatim_quote: The RGM International Airport expansion project is being undertaken by China Jiangsu International for RMB1.045 billion.
claims.claim_text: China Jiangsu International is EPC contractor for RGM Airport expansion, contract value RMB 1.045bn.

claims.verbatim_quote: The groundbreaking ceremony for the Harare airport expansion was held on July 23, 2018.
claims.claim_text: RGM Airport expansion groundbreaking 23 July 2018.

claims.verbatim_quote: The Nairobi Expressway undertaken by China Road and Bridge Corporation started trial operation on May 14, 2022.
claims.claim_text: CRBC is developer/contractor/operator of Nairobi Expressway, trial operation 14 May 2022.

claims.verbatim_quote: Kenya inaugurated the Chinese-built Mombasa-Nairobi railway line on May 31, 2017.
claims.claim_text: CRBC built Mombasa-Nairobi SGR, inaugurated 31 May 2017.

claims.verbatim_quote: Vestas received a 310 MW order for Lake Turkana consisting of 365 turbines.
claims.claim_text: Vestas supplied 365 turbines for 310 MW Lake Turkana Wind Power.

claims.verbatim_quote: The Addis Ababa Light Rail Transit project was constructed by China Railway Group for 475 million USD.
claims.claim_text: CREC constructed Addis Ababa Light Rail, $475m.

claims.verbatim_quote: Addis Ababa Light Rail opened on September 20, 2015.
claims.claim_text: Addis Light Rail opened 20 September 2015.

claims.verbatim_quote: The Ethiopia-Djibouti railway was constructed by China Railway Group and CCECC with financing from Exim Bank of China.
claims.claim_text: CREC and CCECC constructed Ethio-Djibouti Railway with Exim Bank financing.

claims.verbatim_quote: The 752 km Ethiopia-Djibouti railway was inaugurated on October 5, 2016.
claims.claim_text: Ethio-Djibouti Railway inaugurated 5 October 2016.

claims.verbatim_quote: Webuild is the contractor for the Grand Ethiopian Renaissance Dam with 5,150 MW capacity.
claims.claim_text: Webuild (Italy) is contractor for GERD, 5,150 MW.

claims.verbatim_quote: Ethiopia inaugurated the GERD on September 9, 2025.
claims.claim_text: GERD inaugurated 9 September 2025.

claims.verbatim_quote: The New Parliament Building constructed by Shanghai Construction Group was handed over on October 26, 2023.
claims.claim_text: Shanghai Construction Group constructed New Parliament Building, handed over 26 October 2023.

claims.verbatim_quote: China provided RMB 675.8 million grant for New Parliament Building via MOFCOM.
claims.claim_text: China Ministry of Commerce provided RMB 675.8m grant for New Parliament.

claims.verbatim_quote: Mugabe opened the $150 million China-funded Victoria Falls International Airport on November 19, 2016.
claims.claim_text: China Jiangsu built Victoria Falls Airport, $150m Exim Bank loan, opened 19 November 2016.

claims.verbatim_quote: Kenya signed financing agreement with Export-Import Bank of Korea for $94.7m for Kenya-KAIST at Konza.
claims.claim_text: Korea Eximbank provided $94.7m EDCF loan for Kenya-KAIST.

claims.verbatim_quote: A consortium led by China Communications Construction Company won the $484m contract for first three berths at Lamu port on April 11, 2013.
claims.claim_text: CCCC/CRBC won $484m contract for Lamu Port first 3 berths, 11 April 2013.

claims.verbatim_quote: Hawassa Industrial Park was constructed by CCECC and inaugurated on July 20, 2016.
claims.claim_text: CCECC constructed Hawassa Industrial Park, inaugurated 20 July 2016.

claims.verbatim_quote: China Civil Engineering Corporation concluded a $246m deal for Hawassa Industrial Park on July 16, 2015.
claims.claim_text: CCECC $246m deal for Hawassa Industrial Park, 16 July 2015.

claims.verbatim_quote: Daewoo Engineering & Construction won the $161m contract for Kazungula Bridge in August 2014.
claims.claim_text: Daewoo E&C won $161m Kazungula Bridge contract, August 2014.
